original_reference.description: Starapples hang from ashen branches, motes of luscious, red light in a bleached tableau.

interpretation: Six visible source detail clusters are authored as fruit: two larger cross-like marks and four small marks. This is visual glyph interpretation, not a six-fruit yield claim; native Harvestable.OnSuccessAmount is1.

facts: Native ripe/unripe updates assign TileColor and DetailColor. These blueprints declare no RipeTiles or UnripeTiles.
Both states keep primary TileColor g. Ripe detail R and unripe detail K change fruit appearance without replacing this source tile.
Starapple Tree starts with1:5ripe chance; Starapple Tree Ripe starts1:1, but has the same Render/Description and subsequent Harvestable appearance roles.

palette.description_palette_boundary: Description says ashen branches, but native tile primary is g. Express pale/ashen bark through neutral texture values; retain native g tint rather than inventing a third fixed-white bark color.

donor_reference.role: Actual Vanilla Plants Expanded apple tree supplies readable red pome fruit, leaf clustering and outline/shading conventions. Do not copy its round dense crown, straight trunk, cultivar mechanics, donor colors or fruit count.

construction: Editable crooked ashen-textured tree with source-inspired asymmetric sparse crown, exposed branches/root flare and six source-positioned fruit glyphs. Red marks aid fruit ownership extraction; final layers are neutral grayscale.

frame.rule: One fixed frame for primary and fruit role in both harvest states. No per-state crop/recenter; state changes tint only.

states: One fixed map view with ripe/unripe tint states. No creature turnarounds, clothing, random crown, seasonal models or new harvest mechanics are required.
